title: Attempts to discredit Lazar's Los Alamos and S4 employment
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Attempts to discredit Lazar's Los Alamos and S4 employment, about 1980s at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Alamos, New Mexico; S4, Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: they tried to say that he never worked at Los Alamos, but that's been confirmed. And then they tried to say that he was never at Area S4 or Area 51 site 4, but he was there and he knew it.

related.note: Both are about whether Lazar really worked at Los Alamos and S4. The story's teller says his work there was confirmed; Davis says he was only a radiation badge monitor for a logistics contractor and never went to Area 51.

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, talking with another host, Jesse Michels, discusses Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the 1980s at S4, a site said to be part of Area 51, the secret test base in Nevada. Rogan says critics tried to claim Lazar never worked at Los Alamos, the nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, but that this has been confirmed, and that Lazar really was at S4. He draws on Lazar himself and on the journalist George Knapp, and if he is right, the attempts to discredit Lazar fall apart.
